meta.title: Custom grouping instruction typed into the chat input

args.goal: In the already-open Smart Grouping side panel, type a custom grouping rule into the chat input, click the blue send icon, and stop when the panel visibly shows an AI response with grouping logic and the conditions being applied.

steps.note: Performs the chat submission and verifies that the AI response appears in the Smart Grouping panel.
Confirms the response screen has no crash, server error, undefined values, or raw identifiers.
